database: Industry Opportunity Radar (Part 26, Part 29.10 & Addendum A.7)

records.title: Autonomous UI Visual-Context Harvester for CAT/TMS
records.classification: Micro SaaS / AI Agent / Developer Tool
records.problem: Software translators see isolated JSON keys like 'btn_charge_post' without knowing if 'charge' means billing a credit card or charging an EV battery—causing 60%+ of SaaS LQA bugs.
records.product_solution: Headless Playwright + Vision-LLM agent that crawls staging builds on every PR, maps DOM elements back to i18n keys, captures bounding-box screenshots, and pushes visual context + disambiguation notes automatically into Lokalise/Crowdin/Phrase/Smartling.
existing_competitors: Figma plugins (only cover design stage, not live app state)
records.gap_defensibility: Zero-human-click staging crawl tied directly to Git PR diffs and AST key tracing.
records.mvp_spec: GitHub Action + Playwright script that Instruments React i18next keys in DOM data-attributes, captures screenshots of changed routes, and uploads via Lokalise/Crowdin REST API.
records.revenue_model: $99–$499/month SaaS per repository based on active key volume

records.title: EU MDR / IVDR 24-Language IFU Change-Impact & Traceability Engine
records.problem: Medical device manufacturers updating a single safety warning in an English IFU (Instructions for Use) struggle to audit and prove across 24 EU languages and 50+ SKUs that every IDML/PDF leaflet matches the exact regulatory revision.
records.product_solution: Automated XML/IDML/PDF semantic diff and regulatory traceability engine that verifies 24-language alignment against master English source changes and generates ISO 13485 audit-ready verification dossiers.
records.gap_defensibility: Cross-language semantic equivalence verification combined with deterministic regulatory audit trails.
records.mvp_spec: IDML + PDF extractor that aligns multilingual paragraph blocks against source revision diffs and flags missing/untranslated safety warnings.

records.title: Real-Time Cognitive-Relief HUD Copilot for Human Interpreters
records.classification: Micro SaaS / Desktop & Booth Companion App
records.problem: Simultaneous and medical interpreters experience extreme cognitive overload (Gile's Effort Model) when speakers rattle off rapid numbers, dosages, acronyms, and proper nouns.
records.product_solution: Low-latency (<300ms) local/edge audio listener that extracts ONLY numbers (with unit/currency conversions), proper names, and client glossary hits onto a minimalist heads-up display—without distracting full-sentence transcription.
records.gap_defensibility: Ultra-low latency entity/number-only visual ergonomics specifically designed around interpreter cognitive load theory.
records.mvp_spec: Desktop Electron/Tauri app capturing system loopback audio, running streaming ASR + deterministic number/TBX matcher with <250ms display latency.

records.title: Open-Source i18n Defect & Concatenation AST Scanner
records.problem: Developers routinely commit hardcoded strings, string concatenations ('Hello ' + user + ', you have ' + count + ' items'), and broken ICU plural syntax that aren't discovered until localization fails weeks later.
records.product_solution: Tree-sitter AST static analyzer + LLM autofixer CLI that detects hardcoded UI strings, grammar-breaking concatenations, locale-unsafe Date/Number formatting, and auto-rewrites them into ICU MessageFormat.
records.gap_defensibility: Open-source developer adoption bottom-up with automated PR autofix patches.
records.mvp_spec: CLI tool supporting TypeScript/React + Vue + Flutter with GitHub Action PR annotations.
records.revenue_model: Open-core (Free CLI; $49–$299/mo team dashboard & automated PR autofixer)
